Learn to Code

Start your coding journey with this beginner-friendly guide!

What is Coding?

Coding is the process of writing instructions for computers to perform specific tasks. It’s the foundation of all software, websites, and apps.

Steps to Start Coding

1. Choose a Programming Language

Start with beginner-friendly languages like Python, JavaScript, or HTML/CSS. Here are some additional languages to explore:

  • Python - Great for beginners, widely used for web development, data science, and automation.

  • JavaScript - Essential for web development, used for creating interactive websites.

  • HTML - The backbone of web pages, used for structuring content.

  • CSS - Used for styling and designing web pages.

  • Java - A versatile language used for building applications, games, and Android apps.

  • C - A foundational language for system programming and embedded systems.

  • C++ - An extension of C, widely used for game development and high-performance applications.

  • Rust - A modern language focused on safety and performance, great for system programming.

  • Ruby - Known for its simplicity, often used for web development with Ruby on Rails.

Steps to Start Coding

1. Choose a Programming Language

Start with beginner-friendly languages like Python, JavaScript, or HTML/CSS.

2. Set Up Your Environment

Install a code editor like Visual Studio Code or Sublime Text to write and test your code.
